description: Paginate through market index groups. Set fetch_all to merge every page into CSV.

fetch_all.description: Fetch every page (up to 30 pages of 100 rows) and return CSV with a header row instead of one JSON page. Use only when the full set is needed; it is slower and uses more API quota.

name: list_market_groups

pages_fetched.description: With fetch_all: how many pages were merged.

pagination.description: Pass pagination.cursor back as cursor to get the next page.

results.description: Records returned by CDT Express, usually an array of objects.

truncated.description: With fetch_all: true if more pages existed than were fetched.

title: List market groups
